coach_notes: Great job on your recent workouts, Test Athlete! I noticed you're feeling a bit of moderate fatigue, so we'll keep the intensity manageable today. Focus on maintaining good form, especially in your core and glutes, to get the most out of each exercise. Let's keep pushing towards your fat loss goals!

plan.coaching_focus: Keep your chest up and core engaged. Make sure to sit back into the box, not onto it, to protect your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement and avoid arching your lower back. Keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your knees. Engage your core and keep your elbows close to your body as you lower yourself.

nutrition_recovery.hydration_advice: Make sure to drink plenty of water throughout the day, especially after your workout. Aim for at least 500ml of water within the first hour post-workout.
nutrition_recovery.recommended_meal: Grilled chicken breast with quinoa and steamed broccoli. Add a side of Greek yogurt with a handful of mixed berries for a well-rounded, high-protein recovery meal.
